Title: Schema and pack refresh
Purpose: Refresh the template-pack schema so it models role usages, dependencies, artifact inputs, branch coordinates, and shared/local resources explicitly.
ProgressionGate: Must pass architecture review gate A before the next subbundle may begin.
Deliverables: Updated workbook tabs for dependencies and artifact inputs
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle focused on schema mismatches, then rerun gate A.

Title: Baseline scenario realignment
Purpose: Realign the seeded baseline scenarios to the current five-process repository expectations and current step keys.
ProgressionGate: Validator must confirm five expected baseline scenarios and exact key process expectations.
Deliverables: Updated validation assertions for software, branching, and hotfix expectations
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle for baseline drift, then rerun validation.

Title: Process template enhancement
Purpose: Revisit all processes and remove earlier simplifications that were only present because the older module lacked current features.
ProgressionGate: Each process must have detailed roles, artifacts, checklists, validations, prompts, dependencies, and artifact inputs where relevant.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a process-specific corrective subbundle and do not continue until the process passes review.

Title: Mermaid and sidecar driver
Purpose: Ensure every template can export Mermaid flowchart and sequence diagrams plus supporting markdown sidecars.
ProgressionGate: Mermaid exporter and supporting file inventory must cover definition docs and resource docs.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create an exporter corrective subbundle and rerun architecture review gate B.

Title: Runtime projection and import parity
Purpose: Project current-module import envelopes from the pack and verify parity for dependencies, artifact inputs, and decision roles.
ProgressionGate: Projection compatibility reports must show no blocking issues.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a projection corrective subbundle before continuing.

Title: Tests and regression net
Purpose: Strengthen unit tests and validation scripts so future process-module changes surface pack regressions immediately.
ProgressionGate: Test inventory must cover loader, projection, exporter, catalog, and current baseline expectations.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a test-gap corrective subbundle and rerun gate B.

Title: Architecture review gate A
Purpose: Stop after the early pack refresh and re-check schema fidelity before more implementation effort is spent.
ProgressionGate: Must pass or produce a corrective subbundle.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Open a corrective subbundle immediately and prohibit downstream progress.

Title: Corrective subbundle — canvas chrome de-hardcode
Purpose: Address the remaining hardcoded authoring chrome in ProcessCanvasSurfaceFactory so quick-create and group actions become file-driven.
ProgressionGate: Either complete the de-hardcode patch or explicitly accept the debt in the final QA memo.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Escalate as architectural debt that must stay visible in the final bundle.

Title: Architecture review gate B
Purpose: Stop again after projection, Mermaid, and tests to catch wrong architectural direction before final closure.
ProgressionGate: Must pass or produce another corrective subbundle.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Open a corrective subbundle before any final QA activity.

Title: Final QA audit and closure
Purpose: Perform the strict final QA and senior architect inspection, then package the final ZIP only after all gates are satisfied.
ProgressionGate: Final QA memo must state whether any debt remains and why it is or is not acceptable.
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create one more corrective subbundle and repeat the final audit.
